name: Mamanuca Islands
tagline: Resort and day-trip islands off Denarau with lagoon snorkelling and reef surf
description: The Mamanucas are a group of resort and day-trip islands off Denarau. South Sea Island is a 30-minute day trip from Denarau, and Beachcomber Island is reached by catamaran. Mana Island has three beach areas and lagoon snorkelling, while Treasure Island and Bounty Island are marine-reserve islands. Monuriki, an uninhabited island, is where the film Cast Away was shot, and Cloudbreak off Tavarua is a well-known reef surf break.
whyVisit: Escape to an island for the day

goodToKnow.title: Day trips leave Denarau
goodToKnow.detail: Beachcomber Island is reached by catamaran from Denarau, and South Sea Island is a 30-minute trip.

goodToKnow.title: Cloudbreak is for experts
goodToKnow.detail: Cloudbreak is a reef wave off Tavarua, reached by boat, so paddle out only if you are an experienced surfer.

goodToKnow.title: Monuriki needs a boat trip
goodToKnow.detail: Monuriki is uninhabited and off the beaten track, so reach it on a trip arranged with an operator.
